commands.command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/sparse-image-copy
bin/copy-image source.img destination.img
cmp -s source.img destination.img
printf 'SECOND_COPY_CMP=identical\n'
stat -c 'DEST size=%s blocks=%b block_size=%B' destination.img
allocated=$(du -B1 destination.img | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'DEST_ALLOCATED_BYTES=%s\n' "$allocated"
[ "$allocated" -lt 2097152 ]
source_before=$(sha256sum source.img | awk '{print $1}')
if bin/copy-image source.img source.img 2>/tmp/copy-image-same.err; then
  printf 'SAME_FILE_GUARD=unexpected-success\n'
  exit 1
else
  printf 'SAME_FILE_GUARD=rejected\n'
fi
source_after=$(sha256sum source.img | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$source_before" = "$source_after" ]
printf 'SOURCE_INTACT_HASH=%s\n' "$source_after"
printf 'SAME_FILE_MESSAGE='; sed -n '1p' /tmp/copy-image-same.err
